diagnostic_profile.method: External CUDA events captured around model modules in the three-query, single-request decode graph; sampled every sixteen replays after stream synchronization. Two 512-output requests. TP2 and TP4 used the same profiler and prompt construction. These timings include instrumentation overhead; nested intervals are not additive.

limitations: TP4/PP2 did not improve the combined single, concurrent, prefill, and context operating point; TP2/PP4 remains preferred.
The TP4 context limit was 65536; its capacity is not evidence of a successful near-limit retrieval check.
The diagnostic does not establish a hardware asymmetry or a GPU 7-specific bottleneck. It measures closely matched total times within each tensor-parallel group.
Steady-decode targets of 100 single, 300 aggregate at concurrency eight, and 450 at sixteen remain unmet.
